t: How to Plan a Low Buy / No Buy Year - KIRAN SINGH
s: May 3, 2025 - I think a “low buy year” is a great precursor to a “no buy year”. Or just a great way to reduce your consumption. With a low buy year, the idea is to purchase as few unnecessary items as possible, but there are no restrictions on what you can buy. You can set certain rules for yourself, such as “I will purchase X items of clothing”, but the idea is to reduce your number of purchases.
